landmarks.name: Shionomisaki Southernmost Point Monument
landmarks.fact: This stone monument marks Cape Shionomisaki as the southernmost point of Japan's main island of Honshu.

landmarks.name: Shionomisaki Lighthouse
landmarks.fact: Built in 1878, this historic white stone lighthouse guides ships navigating along the southern coast of Honshu.

landmarks.name: Shionomisaki Tourist Tower
landmarks.fact: This tower features an observation deck offering sweeping 360-degree views of the Pacific Ocean and surrounding cape.
